question: Does a new adult personal Google account reach Antigravity and its free tier with no age verification step (government ID, credit card authorization or other method)?
why: The FAQ sends an account that Antigravity holds as age-unverified to Google's age verification. Google's help page says Google asks when it has learned that an account may be under the minimum age, and lists a government ID or a credit card authorization, with other options in some regions. A forum reply says Antigravity checks an age-verification flag separate from the birthday, and a third-party review reports a free sign-in with no card. No vendor page says which new accounts hold the flag. Seeing it needs a sign-up. Until then identity_cost.kind stays email.
